title: Amortize reduced ideal relation search
objective: Select and validate a generic fixed three-admissions-per-reduced-ideal policy for evidence-supported number-field degree/signature bands while preserving exact class/unit semantics, deterministic checkpoints, and measured non-regression gates.
references: Hecke 0.40 BSD NfOrd/Clgp.jl and Clgp/Main_LLL.jl clean-room design observations

oracles: Sage/PARI and pinned C4/quartic expected outputs

handoff.summary: Exact source commit 7d58f169 selects three direct admissions only for the measured signature (1,2) with a nonempty factor base, while retaining the exact collector, presentation, rigorous hR, saturation, checkpoint, and replay boundaries. Matched five-pair warm C4 medians improved from 1.330s to 0.854s public and 0.875s to 0.420s relations; attempts/candidates fell from 10/20 to 4/12. The unchanged quartic control was +0.8% public and -2.0% relations. Prepared-field cold C4 median was 2.556s. Degree 4--6 exact controls had no new failure or regression above 1.10x. Independent exact-SHA review declared the source SAFE.
risks: Automatic p3 selection deliberately excludes every unmeasured signature; future expansion requires its own matched evidence.

The first focused receipt is invalid because an interrupted, origin/main-scoped test:changed build left ignored runtime artifacts inconsistent; a clean rebuild followed by a passing focused receipt at the identical commit and workspace fingerprint.

The cumulative integration pnpm test:native run passed every correctness, FFI, lifecycle, resource, and native-kernel stage. Its final unrelated dense-GF(p) construct_500 microbenchmark measured 8.01--9.23 ms against an 8.00 ms budget on isolated reruns; the integer, rational, and polynomial performance gates passed.
next_steps: Preserve the integrated C4 and quartic performance receipts while expanding the corpus.
Track the unrelated dense-GF(p) construction-budget flake separately; do not weaken its threshold as part of class/unit work.
